label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is a True Positive. The sink `response.sendRedirect(param)` at line 21 accepts user-controlled input `param` (from `request.getParameter` at line 19) without validation or sanitization. Although there is an IP-based guard (`request.getRemoteAddr().startsWith("10.")`), this does not sanitize the URL content. On the executed path where the guard passes, the resolved sink value is attacker-controllable, leading to an Open Redirect vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param flows directly to sendRedirect sink without validation
